findings.highlight: I apologize, so please stop grinning at me like that."
findings.evidenceJa: 悪かったから、笑顔で殺気をみなぎらせるのは止めてくれ」
findings.governingReading: 笑顔で殺気をみなぎらせる combines a smile with an overflowing threatening aura.
findings.explanation: Smiling murderous menace becomes an ordinary grin.

findings.highlight: "I see. So you expected Berserker to grab you from the get-go. Makes sense then, planning to protect yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そっか。遠坂は初めからバーサーカーに掴まれる気だったもんな。そりゃ予め体を守っておくか。
findings.governingReading: 初めから...掴まれる気だった says she planned or meant to undergo the grasp, with advance protection.
findings.explanation: Intending to be grabbed becomes merely expecting it.

findings.highlight: She knows very well not to dwell on what she lost, but to focus on what she gained in exchange.
findings.evidenceJa: 大事なのは失った物ではなくこれから得る物だと、コイツは知っているのだ。
findings.governingReading: これから得る物 is future acquisition opposed to losses already incurred.
findings.explanation: What she will gain becomes what she already gained in exchange.
